domain: Digital Mind Mapping and Collaborative Visualization
scenario:
A digital collaboration platform company is developing an enterprise-level mind mapping and visualization tool designed to enhance brainstorming, planning, and idea development processes. The platform aims to support teams and individuals in organizing their thoughts and ideas through dynamic and interactive visual maps. These maps are composed of nodes that represent concepts or ideas, and they can be customized with various attributes such as position, size, shape, and associated comments.

Users can collaboratively create and modify mind maps in real-time, facilitating team brainstorming sessions and efficient project planning. The platform requires a robust system to track changes made by different users, manage user permissions, and store metadata about each node, such as its creator, timestamp, and whether it can be modified.

To support these capabilities, the platform will include advanced features like version control for nodes, analytics to track user engagement and activity, and integration with other productivity tools. The system must also ensure data integrity and security while providing a seamless user experience across different devices and operating systems.
